hero.title: I design and build AI-powered web products, from architecture to the last pixel.
hero.subtitle: Software Engineer focused on Product Engineering & Web Experiences. I design systems, components, and agents that connect UX, infrastructure, and AI into production-ready products.
hero.bullet_1: Web architecture and development with Next.js, Astro, TypeScript, and decoupled stacks.
hero.bullet_2: Token-first design systems and npm libraries for distributed product teams.
hero.bullet_3: AI integrations (MCP servers, LLMs, automation) that enable non-technical teams.
hero.subcopy: Open to freelance and full-time roles in product engineering.

statement.text: From architecture to the last pixel.

stack.heading: Trusted by design-led companies & engineering teams
stack.subheading: I partner with teams across LATAM, the US, and Europe that take product design, architecture, and applied AI seriously.
stack.body: From early-stage startups to established product teams, I collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering to ship web experiences, integrate AI into real workflows, and turn decisions into production code.
stack.body_2: A few of the teams and brands I've worked with across industries and geographies.
stack.bullet_1: Remote-first collaboration with founders, PMs, designers, and engineers worldwide.
stack.bullet_2: Production work: landing pages, design systems, AI-powered tools, and full-stack platforms.
stack.bullet_3: Focus on craft, performance, and fast iteration across time zones.

why.statement: I design like a product thinker and build like an engineer.
why.row_1_body: I design with business goals, user behavior, and technical constraints in mind.
why.row_2_body: My work translates cleanly into systems, components, and production-ready code.
why.row_3_body: I use AI where it improves workflows, tools, or product value.
why.row_4_body: I work fast with founders, designers, and engineers across the full product cycle.
why.svc_1_body: I define, design, and build new features or full products. Light research, UX/UI, prototypes, and fullstack development in the same flow.
why.svc_2_body: I build sites, dashboards, and web apps integrating APIs, databases, and external services ready for production.
why.svc_3_body: I design and build context-aware interfaces where AI makes sense, turning it into agents and automations that improve your product and internal processes.
why.svc_4_body: I create or evolve your design system, component libraries, and internal tools so product, design, and dev work on the same foundation.
why.svc_5_body: Data-driven optimization for active products. I analyze user flows, performance bottlenecks, and retention metrics to deploy targeted improvements.
why.svc_6_body: I guide founders and small teams to make good stack, architecture, and integration decisions. Thinking about what you'll need in 6 to 12 months, not just the next sprint.

projects.heading: Product work I'm proud of.

about.heading_before: Companies partner with me for my
about.bullet_1: I connect product thinking, UX, and engineering, so decisions make sense for users, the business, and the codebase.
about.bullet_2: I care about the craft, from the architecture and design system to the final micro-interaction in production.
about.bullet_3: I define scalable systems (design tokens, components, internal tools) that help teams move faster instead of starting from scratch every time.
about.bullet_4: I use AI with intention, turning it into workflows, agents, and tools that actually help teams ship better work.
